description: Prospective soccer SPEC challengers on the served Poisson goals joint (not refits of the sealed models), recorded point-in-time at the served 06:00 UTC cutoff, at the served lines, in the separate challenger store and scored at read time against the served forecast. Registration is never promotion. Corners skipped; Asian handicap research-only and blocked on the preregistration; international skipped for insufficient evidence.

spec.name: soccer_goals_dc
spec.head: goals
spec.why: Dixon-Coles low-score correction (ev.dc_joint) on the served Poisson means; one rho fitted by maximum likelihood on the labelled inputs available at each cutoff.

provenance.registered_by: learning-phase2 I7 seed (Claude Sonnet 5.5); owner review pending
provenance.note: Manual operator seed (docs/SOCCER_MARKETS_PLAN.md goals family): one change from the sealed Poisson goals model that already exists in soccer_markets_eval; priced for 1X2, match/team goals and BTTS at the served lines; double chance and draw no bet derived at read time. Not served.
